meta.title: Battle Dialogue · Taxing Expedition
meta.description: The twisting tracks below the high wall, the unyielding cries in the struggle.

units.rawText: Tartarus Sector. Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.
units.displayText: Tartarus Sector. Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.

spans.text: Tartarus Sector. Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.

units.rawText: Are you guys okay?
units.displayText: Are you guys okay?

spans.text: Are you guys okay?

units.rawText: I'm fine, but Electra...
units.displayText: I'm fine, but Electra...

spans.text: I'm fine, but Electra...

units.rawText: (Coughs) Sorry, Atlas...
units.displayText: (Coughs) Sorry, Atlas...

spans.text: (Coughs) Sorry, Atlas...

units.rawText: It's okay, save your strength. How's she doing, buddy?
units.displayText: It's okay, save your strength. How's she doing, buddy?

spans.text: It's okay, save your strength. How's she doing, buddy?

units.rawText: We need to find a safe place to treat Electra. But all the roads leading to the Outer Ring are blockaded by Entropics...
units.displayText: We need to find a safe place to treat Electra. But all the roads leading to the Outer Ring are blockaded by Entropics...

spans.text: We need to find a safe place to treat Electra. But all the roads leading to the Outer Ring are blockaded by Entropics...

units.rawText: I look at the Rubik's Map and shake my head. Given our present circumstances, breaking through their encirclement intact would be a tall order.
units.displayText: I look at the Rubik's Map and shake my head. Given our present circumstances, breaking through their encirclement intact would be a tall order.

spans.text: I look at the Rubik's Map and shake my head. Given our present circumstances, breaking through their encirclement intact would be a tall order.

units.rawText: Where did all these Entropics come from? I've never seen this many Entropics show up all of a sudden even on the Border Battlefront.
units.displayText: Where did all these Entropics come from? I've never seen this many Entropics show up all of a sudden even on the Border Battlefront.

spans.text: Where did all these Entropics come from? I've never seen this many Entropics show up all of a sudden even on the Border Battlefront.

units.rawText: And then there's that High-Order Entropic... She didn't seem hurt after that attack just now...
units.displayText: And then there's that High-Order Entropic... She didn't seem hurt after that attack just now...

spans.text: And then there's that High-Order Entropic... She didn't seem hurt after that attack just now...

units.rawText: Yes, I saw her getting up while we were withdrawing...
units.displayText: Yes, I saw her getting up while we were withdrawing...

spans.text: Yes, I saw her getting up while we were withdrawing...

units.rawText: This section of the labyrinth is filled with lurid purple indicators. Even a Greater Sanctifier would not be able to escape unscathed.
units.displayText: This section of the labyrinth is filled with lurid purple indicators. Even a Greater Sanctifier would not be able to escape unscathed.

spans.text: This section of the labyrinth is filled with lurid purple indicators. Even a Greater Sanctifier would not be able to escape unscathed.

units.rawText: Worse still, they've got that red-haired High-Order Entropic who's spoiling for a fight among them. If we want to turn the situation around, we'll need to break some rules.
units.displayText: Worse still, they've got that red-haired High-Order Entropic who's spoiling for a fight among them. If we want to turn the situation around, we'll need to break some rules.

spans.text: Worse still, they've got that red-haired High-Order Entropic who's spoiling for a fight among them. If we want to turn the situation around, we'll need to break some rules.

units.rawText: I'm sorry. If I hadn't been so eager to destroy that main energy tower, we wouldn't have been trapped here...
units.displayText: I'm sorry. If I hadn't been so eager to destroy that main energy tower, we wouldn't have been trapped here...

spans.text: I'm sorry. If I hadn't been so eager to destroy that main energy tower, we wouldn't have been trapped here...

units.rawText: It's alright, Alcyone. This isn't the time for blaming yourself.
units.displayText: It's alright, Alcyone. This isn't the time for blaming yourself.

spans.text: It's alright, Alcyone. This isn't the time for blaming yourself.

units.rawText: The main energy tower... That's right, if we can use the power from the main energy tower...
units.displayText: The main energy tower... That's right, if we can use the power from the main energy tower...

spans.text: The main energy tower... That's right, if we can use the power from the main energy tower...

units.rawText: I open my terminal and quickly scan through the recon data that Alcyone sent over earlier.
units.displayText: I open my terminal and quickly scan through the recon data that Alcyone sent over earlier.

spans.text: I open my terminal and quickly scan through the recon data that Alcyone sent over earlier.

units.rawText: A reading that's over five times that of normal energy towers... it's this one.
units.displayText: A reading that's over five times that of normal energy towers... it's this one.

spans.text: A reading that's over five times that of normal energy towers... it's this one.

units.rawText: Looks like you've thought of something, buddy!
units.displayText: Looks like you've thought of something, buddy!

spans.text: Looks like you've thought of something, buddy!

units.rawText: Comms are cut. Alcyone, send up a signal arrow to tell Eosphorus and Eos that we're breaking through into the Middle Ring.
units.displayText: Comms are cut. Alcyone, send up a signal arrow to tell Eosphorus and Eos that we're breaking through into the Middle Ring.

spans.text: Comms are cut. Alcyone, send up a signal arrow to tell Eosphorus and Eos that we're breaking through into the Middle Ring.

units.rawText: Into the Middle Ring? But the Rubik's Map says...
units.displayText: Into the Middle Ring? But the Rubik's Map says...

spans.text: Into the Middle Ring? But the Rubik's Map says...

units.rawText: According to the map data, this region does not currently contain a path that leads to the Middle Ring.
units.displayText: According to the map data, this region does not currently contain a path that leads to the Middle Ring.

spans.text: According to the map data, this region does not currently contain a path that leads to the Middle Ring.

units.rawText: But that's just what the map says.
units.displayText: But that's just what the map says.

spans.text: But that's just what the map says.

units.rawText: I point to the location of the main energy tower on the Rubik's Map, enclosed by sturdy walls.
units.displayText: I point to the location of the main energy tower on the Rubik's Map, enclosed by sturdy walls.

spans.text: I point to the location of the main energy tower on the Rubik's Map, enclosed by sturdy walls.

units.rawText: What if we got rid of those walls?
units.displayText: What if we got rid of those walls?

spans.text: What if we got rid of those walls?

units.rawText: You mean to...
units.displayText: You mean to...

spans.text: You mean to...

units.rawText: Well done, buddy!
units.displayText: Well done, buddy!

spans.text: Well done, buddy!

units.rawText: We couldn't bust down those walls before, but it'll be a piece of cake with that energy tower!
units.displayText: We couldn't bust down those walls before, but it'll be a piece of cake with that energy tower!

spans.text: We couldn't bust down those walls before, but it'll be a piece of cake with that energy tower!

units.rawText: Atlas, we need to gather the tower's operands into one point...
units.displayText: Atlas, we need to gather the tower's operands into one point...

spans.text: Atlas, we need to gather the tower's operands into one point...

units.rawText: Leave it to me, buddy! I won't let a single Entropic near you guys, so relax and tweak the tower!
units.displayText: Leave it to me, buddy! I won't let a single Entropic near you guys, so relax and tweak the tower!

spans.text: Leave it to me, buddy! I won't let a single Entropic near you guys, so relax and tweak the tower!

units.rawText: I'll do it with you, Atlas! It was because of me that Electra... I need to protect Electra.
units.displayText: I'll do it with you, Atlas! It was because of me that Electra... I need to protect Electra.

spans.text: I'll do it with you, Atlas! It was because of me that Electra... I need to protect Electra.

units.rawText: Hahaha, alright then, we haven't worked together in a while!
units.displayText: Hahaha, alright then, we haven't worked together in a while!

spans.text: Hahaha, alright then, we haven't worked together in a while!

units.rawText: Atlas ruffles Alcyone's hair, and Electra smiles weakly while leaning against Atlas.
units.displayText: Atlas ruffles Alcyone's hair, and Electra smiles weakly while leaning against Atlas.

spans.text: Atlas ruffles Alcyone's hair, and Electra smiles weakly while leaning against Atlas.

units.rawText: Right, let's head toward the main energy tower. Atlas and Alcyone, you'll stop the Entropic advance. I'll adjust the tower's power supply. Electra will stay with me.
units.displayText: Right, let's head toward the main energy tower. Atlas and Alcyone, you'll stop the Entropic advance. I'll adjust the tower's power supply. Electra will stay with me.

spans.text: Right, let's head toward the main energy tower. Atlas and Alcyone, you'll stop the Entropic advance. I'll adjust the tower's power supply. Electra will stay with me.

units.rawText: Everyone, move out!
units.displayText: Everyone, move out!

spans.text: Everyone, move out!
